 Will Ronaldo and His Son Play Together? BIG Update on Al-Nassr Plans
 Sportsdunia Desk Published -  Nov 18, 2026, 10:08 AM 3 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Cristiano Ronaldo Cristiano Jr Al Nassr Summary
 Reports of Cristiano Ronaldo and his son playing together are doing the rounds on social media.
 Cristiano Ronaldo Júnior debuted for the Portugal under-17s in the European Championship qualifIERS.
 The news is still pending confirmation from Al-Nassr or the player himself.
 Cristiano Ronaldo could be on the verge of another historic milestone. Fans can see him playing a professional match alongside his eldest son, Cristiano Jr. Al-Nassr reportedly may be planning a scenario that would go down in football history. The Saudi Pro League club wants to extend Ronaldo's contract, opening the door to an extraordinary experience of him sharing the pitch with his son.
 Apparently, the management plans to make a special proposal to convince Cristiano Ronaldo to continue for at least two more seasons in Saudi Arabia. The grand scheme involves his son making his debut in professional football in the Portuguese star's final season. Fans have been left with questions ever since the news has been flying around on social media. Everybody is left wondering: ‘Will Ronaldo and his son play together?’
 Cristiano Jr. Future and Development
 Cristiano Ronaldo Júnior has just made his debut for the Portugal under-17s, coming off the bench in a 4-0 win over Andorra in the European Championship qualifier in Lisbon. The Al Nassr academy player plays as a forward, following in the footsteps of his father.
 Al-Nassr intends to promote the player to the senior team next season. The move could see him sharing the locker room with his father, and eventually the football field. But things remain dependent on the teenager’s development and on the management’s sporting decisions in the coming months.
 Advertisement
 Will Cristiano Ronaldo's retire from professional football in 2027?
 The former Manchester United forward has enjoyed a glorious 22-year career, winning every accolade that is there to be won as a footballer. The 5-time Ballon d'Or winner could now be nearing the twilight of his illustrious career.
 While the prized achievement of becoming the first player ever to hit 1000 goals is still keeping him going, the record will be achieved soon, as only 15 goals remain to hit the mark. The player could announce his retirement after this unprecedented landmark, having already announced his farewell from the National team earlier this year.
 Al-Nassr is thus preparing an offer that could be impossible to refuse for the prolific goal-scorer, to make Cristiano Ronaldo and Cristiano Jr. play together. Although the plans remain rumored, it could lure Ronaldo into extending his contract, which currently expires in June 2027.
 What the future holds?
 The 41-year-old is under contract with the Saudi club until June 2027, the same month Cristiano Jr. turns 17. While the scenario seems real, it all depends on Cristiano Jr.'s growth through the youth ranks. The news remains unconfirmed as of today, pending official announcements by the club or the player himself.
 For now, the possibility keeps fans across the globe excited to see one of the greatest footballers of all time partner his son in a competitive game. While the ambitious scenario is subject to multiple factors, it can no longer be seen as a mere daydream. The rumors have caught wind after Ronaldo Jr.'s debut with the national u17 side. Fans could witness the father-son duo sharing the field in a historic moment that would add another feather in Ronaldo's glittering career.
